headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Hetzner documentation audit covered 867 pages across multi-project topology with 100% crawl coverage. Retrieval readiness scores 38.17/100 (weak band), driven by 15.22% chunkability and 0% answerability, indicating severe AI/RAG compatibility issues. API reference coverage is 61.54% across 50 detected API pages. SEO/geo issues affect 45.67% of pages. 5 confirmed broken internal links exist, with 50 additional links unverified due to auth/rate-limit blocks.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

key_findings.headline: Missing required doc layers
key_findings.business_consequence: Backfill concept/how-to/reference coverage for key capabilities.

priority_actions.title: Restructure top 100 pages (by traffic) to add explicit H2/H3 question headings and concise answer paragraphs, targeting 60%+ answerability
priority_actions.why_this_first: Raising answerability from 0% directly enables AI chatbot accuracy and reduces support ticket volume within 30 days.

priority_actions.title: Refactor high-traffic pages with chunkability below 15.22% baseline: break long sections, add semantic headers, limit paragraph length to <150 words
priority_actions.why_this_first: Improving chunkability from 15.22% unlocks vector search quality and LLM context precision, directly improving AI-powered search and support.

priority_actions.title: Create usage/integration docs for the 38.46% API surface gap (19 of 50 API pages missing usage context), prioritizing top 10 API endpoints by call volume
priority_actions.why_this_first: Closing API usage gaps for high-traffic endpoints reduces developer time-to-first-call and support escalations within 30 days.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (867 of 868 discovered pages indexed)
90.31% of pages include last-updated metadata, supporting freshness signals
100% citationability indicates stable URLs and anchor structure for attribution
risks: 0% answerability score means pages lack structured Q&A patterns, crippling LLM-based support automation and chatbot accuracy
15.22% chunkability indicates dense or poorly structured content that fragments badly for vector search and AI retrieval
45.67% SEO/geo issue rate threatens organic discoverability and regional search ranking
38.46% of API surface lacks usage documentation (50 API pages detected, 61.54% coverage), risking developer onboarding friction
limitations: External audit cannot verify content technical accuracy, correctness of code examples, or alignment with actual product API behavior.
25% confidence on link verification means up to 50 unverified links may include false negatives; auth-protected or rate-limited targets were not fully tested.
Chunkability and answerability scores reflect structural heuristics, not actual LLM performance; real-world RAG accuracy requires live testing with production queries.
automation_first: Deploy pre-commit linter to enforce H2/H3 question-style headings and <150-word paragraph limits on all markdown files, targeting the 0% answerability and 15.22% chunkability gaps; expected payoff is sustained AI retrieval quality and reduced manual content audits.

Implement CI check to flag new pages missing meta descriptions or hreflang tags, preventing addition to the existing 45.67% SEO/geo issue pool (396 pages); expected payoff is halting SEO debt accumulation and protecting organic traffic growth.

Automate weekly broken link scan with auth-token injection to resolve the 50 unverified link blind spot and catch new breakage before user impact; expected payoff is continuous link health visibility and faster MTTR for navigation issues.
